---
title: Watermark
author:
  - name: Test Author
    email: test@example.org
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: report
    layout: full
  typst-extras:
    watermark: DRAFT
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: With typst-extras watermark, every page of a full mcanouil report, the cover and the chapter dividers included, carries the watermark text.
        check: bash _checks/extras.sh watermark
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['#set page\(foreground: typst-extras-watermark\(text: "DRAFT"']
---
